label: Aristotle, Metaphysics IV.5, 1009a9-12: There are opinions of a content and its expressed…
interpretation: The parenthesis says many people opine opposites to one another; its conclusion speaks of the same thing being and not being. The pilot selects the contradictory-content reading, represented by an expressed-negation operation. This is not yet a logical contradiction: the stronger interpretation that truth of the expressed negation negates truth of the content is a separate unattributed open premise.
